say:1:1430217101:1.text: Well said. I told my parents something similar a few days ago...
say:1:1430217101:1.source_cn: 说的很好，我前几天也用类似的话试探过我的父母。
say:1:1430217101:1.male: Well said. I told my parents something similar a few days ago...
say:1:1430217101:1.female: Well said. I told my parents something similar a few days ago...

say:2:1430217102:1.text: They were furious. They said they would never allow me to marry a commoner.
say:2:1430217102:1.source_cn: 他们勃然大怒！绝不会允许我和平民出身的人结合……
say:2:1430217102:1.male: They were furious. They said they would never allow me to marry a commoner.
say:2:1430217102:1.female: They were furious. They said they would never allow me to marry a commoner.

say:3:1430217103:1.text: But I think as long as two people truly love each other, it shouldn't be a problem.
say:3:1430217103:1.source_cn: 可我觉得只要两人真心相爱，这些都不是问题。
say:3:1430217103:1.male: But I think as long as two people truly love each other, it shouldn't be a problem.
say:3:1430217103:1.female: But I think as long as two people truly love each other, it shouldn't be a problem.
